Messages.Author: J Miguel Baker
Messages.Body:
Assume Dre had a Leather Jacket and a Grenade, then got into combat.

At close range, Dre tosses his grenade. His opponent takes 3 damage, and
Dre takes 1. Can Dre then burn the Leather Jacket to prevent the damage
from
the Grenade to himself? If so, does the 3 damage still affect his opponent?

John Baker

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Moot.

"Damage from a strike" only includes damage done to the opposing target.
Side effect damage is not counted as "damage from a strike".
